summary: Set Record Properties: writes property values to an existing cloud database record when Do is triggered.
description: SetDbModelProperties (Set Record Properties) updates the record identified by `modelId` in the class chosen with the `collectionName` (Class) parameter. Each class property becomes a value input; triggering `store` (Do) applies the connected inputs to the local record and saves them to the server, firing `stored` (Success) on confirmation or `failure` with `error` on problems. `storeType` (Store to) can switch the node to 'Local only', which updates the in-memory record without any server call — useful for optimistic UI or scratch state. By default only the properties you actually supply are sent (`storeProperties` = 'Only specified'); 'All' sends the record's entire current data. Because the shared local record is updated, every bound Record node and live query in the app sees the change immediately.
whenToUse: The save half of every edit form, and the way to flip a single field ('mark done') from a list row. To create a record use NewDbModelProperties; to remove one use DeleteDbModelProperties; for BYOB backends use noodl.byob.UpdateRecord.

ports.store: Signal (displayed as Do); saves to cloud (default) or applies locally, depending on `storeType`.
ports.stored: Signal (displayed as Success); fires after the server confirms the save (or immediately after a local-only store).
ports.modelId: Value input: id of the record to update (a record object is also accepted). Shown while `idSource` is 'Specify explicitly'.
ports.idSource: Edit-only choice: 'Specify explicitly' uses `modelId`; 'From repeater' targets the record driving the nearest enclosing For Each item.
ports.storeProperties: Edit-only choice ('Only specified' / 'All'): whether to send just the supplied property inputs or the record's whole data. Shown while `storeType` is cloud.
ports.storeType: Edit-only choice ('Cloud and local' / 'Local only'): whether the save reaches the server or only the in-memory record.
ports.accessControl: Edit-only list of access rules applied with the save; each rule expands into its own Target/Read/Write inputs.

runtimeBehavior: Ports are runtime-determined: `collectionName` (Class) is registered as an edit-only enum of the project's classes plus _User/_Role, and each schema property of the chosen class becomes a value input `prop-<name>` typed from the schema. Access Control rules spawn `acl-<ruleId>-*` inputs like on Create New Record. An authoring tool should set `collectionName` in parameters and drive the `prop-<name>` inputs it intends to change.
patterns: DbModel2 `prop-<name>` → Text Input `startValue`, edited `text` → `prop-<name>`, Button `onClick` → `store`: prefill, edit, save.
'From repeater' `idSource` inside a list row: one node updates whichever record the row represents.
antiPatterns: Setting `storeProperties` to 'All' to 'be safe' — it uploads the record's entire local data and can overwrite fields other users changed; send only what the form edits.
